content: संचरः .²1 Passage, transit from one zodiacal sign to another. .²2 A way, path; यत्रौषधिप्रकाशेन नक्तं दर्शितसंचराः <ls>Ku. 6. 43</ls>; <ls>R. 16. 12</ls>. .²3 A narrow road, defile, difficult passage. .²4 Entrance, gate. .²5 The body. .²6 Killing. .²7 Development. --{%a.%} Going about, moving everywhere; अनिरुक्तस्त्रयोदशः स्तोभः संचरो हुंकारः <ls>Ch. Up. 1. 13. 3</ls>.
